properties.description: an_assumption_says_how_it_is_held.rs (4 tests): a model's two idealizations assumed with held_as model, and an argument's principle with held_as principle, raise no reasoning_not_as_stated gap and no NOT AS STATED line in loop_status, are counted in reasoning.assumptions_held_on_purpose with their ids, and read "held on purpose" in reasoning_report while the claim reads conditional. An assumption with nothing said reads exactly as before (one gap, undischarged_assumptions 1, no new field) and the gap names held_as. held_as is refused on a statement of kind hypothesis and with nothing assumed.
properties.findings: On main 983811cae all 4 FAIL: `held_as` is not a parameter of add_inference (refused before it ran), and the unmarked case's gap does not name held_as (its count, 1, already matched, so the old reading is unchanged). With the fix all 4 pass, and the whole MCP in_memory program (933) and the core in_memory program pass; the readings golden moved only on detect_gaps for six fixtures, and putting the old gap wording back into the dumped readings gives main's golden digests exactly (2026-10-27).
